quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$
claim: 作者还提出，为提升极长序列任务的计算性能，可将自注意力限制为只考虑以输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization
claim: 因此本文提出 Transformer，完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖，从而允许显著更多的并行化 [S1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：主流序列转换模型依赖复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，其固有的顺序计算特性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 此外使用多头注意力，将查询、键、值线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；本文采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 dk=dv=dmodel/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
claim: 此外使用多头注意力，将查询、键、值线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；本文采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 dk=dv=dmodel/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token. The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based on a different document.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART），将检索文档视为隐变量并端到端训练 [S2.p1][S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者在初步实验中发现，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档；此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.
claim: 作者希望将混合参数与非参数记忆的方法从抽取式任务扩展到序列到序列生成模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均超过 BART 的 Q-BLEU-1 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络在 CIFAR-10 上的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是因为过拟合，且该网络对此小数据集可能过大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证错误率为 4.49%，超过此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: An obstacle to answering this question was the notorious problem of vanishing/exploding gradients
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练误差反而升高（退化问题），而这一问题并非由梯度消失/爆炸导致 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。

quote: This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证错误率为 4.49%，超过此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: Here we are interested in the improvements of replacing VGG-16 with ResNet-101.
claim: 此外，论文在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测评估，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases.
claim: 现有方法如思维链提示和基于人类演示的后训练，其性能受限于人类提供的范例，且难以探索非人类式的更优推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts.
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习自我演化出推理能力，从而减少对人工标注推理轨迹的依赖 [S1.p2]。

quote: by constraining models to replicate human thought processes, their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars, which prevents the exploration of superior, non-human-like reasoning pathways.
claim: 现有方法如思维链提示和基于人类演示的后训练，其性能受限于人类提供的范例，且难以探索非人类式的更优推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: For DeepSeek-R1-Zero, we employ rule-based rewards to deliver precise feedback for data in mathematical, coding, and logical reasoning domains.
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1-Zero，使用基于规则的奖励，包括准确性奖励和格式奖励，格式奖励要求模型将推理过程置于 <think> 和 </think> 标签内 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p3]。

quote: the model is incentivized to encapsulate its reasoning process within designated tags, specifically ‘ <think> ’ and ‘ </think> ’.
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1-Zero，使用基于规则的奖励，包括准确性奖励和格式奖励，格式奖励要求模型将推理过程置于 <think> 和 </think> 标签内 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p3]。

quote: from 50% to 57% on AIME24
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
claim: 在数据选择上，联合考虑难度、多样性、质量很重要，随机选择、最长推理轨迹或仅最大多样性平均在 AIME24 上差约 30%；在 59K 全量数据池上训练相比 1K 选择没有显著增益 [S1.p3]。

quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展与强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: jointly incorporating difficulty, diversity, and quality measures into our selection algorithm is important
claim: 在数据选择上，联合考虑难度、多样性、质量很重要，随机选择、最长推理轨迹或仅最大多样性平均在 AIME24 上差约 30%；在 59K 全量数据池上训练相比 1K 选择没有显著增益 [S1.p3]。

quote: If we want the model to spend more test-time compute on a problem, we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and instead append “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace to encourage more exploration.
claim: 作者构建了 s1K，即 1,000 个精心挑选的问题及其推理轨迹和答案，蒸馏自 Gemini Thinking Experimental，并对现成预训练模型做监督微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
claim: 9.2%），在 MATH500 上高 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；样本效率方面，400 条样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升到 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升到 94.8，超过 800 条后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
claim: 9.2%），在 MATH500 上高 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；样本效率方面，400 条样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升到 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升到 94.8，超过 800 条后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能为 78.1%，优于 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 等基线 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: On MATH500, LIMO achieves a notable 95.6% accuracy, surpassing QwQ-32B-Preview (89.8%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (85.5%).
claim: LIMO 在域内任务上取得最佳结果：AIME24 准确率 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；MATH500 准确率 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；AMC23 达到 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples covering mathematics, science, coding, and puzzles
claim: 实验以 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 为基座模型，使用 LIMO 的 800 条样本进行监督微调，并与 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 等更大规模开源推理数据集在相同骨干上比较 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: we performed a sweep over the window size, history processing, and decoding temperature
claim: 作者还进行了超参数扫描，包括窗口大小、历史处理和解码温度 [S4.p6]。

quote: Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
claim: 消融实验表明，没有 SWE-agent 的文件编辑器接口时性能降至 10.3%（下降 7.7），文件查看器显示行数过少（30 行，下降 3.7）或过多（整个文件，下降 5.3）都会降低性能 [S5.SS1.p4]。

quote: we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance.
claim: 作者假设 LM 固定，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳配置 [S2.p4]。

quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何为语言模型 agent 设计专门的接口，以提升其完成软件工程任务的能力 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，由 LM 和 ACI 组成，通过迭代生成 thought 和 command 并接收环境反馈来与计算机交互 [S1.p3][S3.p1]。

quote: We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
claim: 作者承认，为解决元学习挑战而做了某些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术是否在模型从头训练时也有效 [S6.p1]。

quote: We evaluate 1) whether Quiet-STaR improves a language model’s ability to directly predict answers in datasets that require reasoning; and, 2) the distribution of impacts resulting from thinking tokens.
claim: 所有实验均从 Mistral 7B 基础版本开始 [S5.p1]。

quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
claim: 所有实验均从 Mistral 7B 基础版本开始 [S5.p1]。

quote: We use REINFORCE to provide a learning signal to rationales based on their impact on future-token prediction.
claim: 算法分三步：在输入序列的 n 个 token 处并行生成 r 个长度为 t 的理由，并插入可学习的思考开始/结束 token [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础语言模型 logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS3.p1]；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成参数，并采用教师强制技巧把思考后多个 token 的预测纳入损失 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

quote: In this work, we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence.
claim: Quiet-STaR 在每对观测 token 之间引入辅助的“理由”变量，目标是优化语言模型生成中间思考，使其能更好地预测剩余序列 [S3.p1]。

quote: 5. SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.
claim: 论文在五个任务上进行评估：GSM8K（128 道随机测试题）、MATH（128 道随机测试题）、MiniF2F-MATH（130 道 Lean4 形式化题）、CodeContests（Python3 竞赛编程题）和 SWE-bench Lite（真实 GitHub 问题）[S2.p4]。

quote: However, as the number of samples increases, all three of the weaker models exceed GPT-4o’s single-attempt performance.
claim: 在五个任务上，覆盖率随样本预算增加而平滑提升；当所有模型只给一次尝试时 GPT-4o 优于 Llama 和 DeepSeek 模型，但随着样本数增加，三个较弱模型均超过 GPT-4o 的单次尝试表现 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: In contrast, the tools available for verifying solutions to math word problems from GSM8K and MATH are limited, necessitating additional verification methods that decide on a single final answer from many (often conflicting) samples.
claim: 在可自动验证的任务中（如 Lean 证明检查器、代码单元测试），精度自动解决，覆盖率提升直接转化为成功率；在数学应用题等缺乏自动验证工具的任务中，则需要额外的验证方法从多个样本中选出最终答案 [S2.p2]。

quote: When proving formal statements in Lean, proof checkers can quickly identify whether a candidate solution is correct.
claim: 在可自动验证的任务中（如 Lean 证明检查器、代码单元测试），精度自动解决，覆盖率提升直接转化为成功率；在数学应用题等缺乏自动验证工具的任务中，则需要额外的验证方法从多个样本中选出最终答案 [S2.p2]。

quote: While success rates initially increase with the number of samples for all three methods, they plateau around 100 samples.
claim: 在缺乏自动验证器的数学应用题设置中，多数投票和奖励模型在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，而覆盖率继续增加并最终超过 95%，导致两者差距扩大 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用任务难以收集大规模监督训练数据，且人类通常只需简短指令或极少示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。

quote: we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning
claim: 少样本评估时从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 n_ctx=2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 175B achieves 85 F1 in the few-shot setting, only a few points behind measured human performance and state-of-the-art fine-tuned models.
claim: 在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 175B 少样本达到 85 F1，仅比人类基线和最先进微调模型低几个点 [S3.F7]。

quote: GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model
claim: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其规模是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。

quote: a bug in the filtering caused us to ignore some overlaps, and due to the cost of training it was not feasible to retrain the model
claim: 在数据污染方面，作者承认由于过滤 bug 未能完全移除重叠，且无法确定干净子集与原数据集同分布 [S2.SS2.p4][S4.p10]。

quote: Compared to prior versions of Llama, we improved both the quantity and quality of the data we use for pre-training and post-training.
claim: 作者通过扩大数据规模、模型规模和训练计算量来提升模型质量，并系统评估其性能 [S1.p5]。

quote: Our 405B model outperforms GPT-4 and Nemotron 4 340B, with Claude 3.5 Sonnet leading among larger models.
claim: 405B 模型在 MMLU 和 MMLU-Pro 上优于 GPT-4 和 Nemotron 4 340B，但 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在较大模型中领先 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p3]。

quote: We find that our Llama 3 models that train a small video adapter during post-training are very competitive, and in some cases even better, than other models that potentially leverage native multimodal processing all the way from pre-training.
claim: 多模态方面，Llama 3-V 405B 在所有图像识别基准上优于 GPT-4V，但略落后于 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet [S7.SS6.p2]；视频适配器具有竞争力，有时甚至优于其他模型 [S7.SS7.p3]；语音接口在 ASR 上优于 Whisper 和 SeamlessM4T [S8.SS4.p3]。

quote: We increase the RoPE base frequency hyperparameter to 500,000.
claim: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，相比 Llama 2 仅有少量修改，包括使用分组查询注意力、128K token 词表和将 RoPE 基频提高到 500,000 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰 Llama 3 模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，接近最先进水平；较小模型在同参数规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。

quote: The model is initialized with pre-trained weights from the Qwen2.5 LLM.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 整体架构由大语言模型、视觉编码器和跨模态投影器三部分组成，语言模型以 Qwen2.5 LLM 预训练权重初始化，并将一维 RoPE 改为对齐绝对时间的多模态旋转位置嵌入 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: For MMMU-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1, surpassing the previous open-source state-of-the-art models and achieving performance comparable to GPT-4o.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上得分 70.2，在 MMMU-Pro 上得分 51.1，超过此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: In college-level problems, Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: 实验在多种数据集上评估 Qwen2.5-VL，并与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等模型比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Despite these efforts, achieving optimal modality alignment remains an ongoing challenge that requires further advancements.
claim: 论文指出，将 CoT 推理应用于视觉语言模型的一个关键挑战是模型依赖文本和视觉两种模态，中间推理步骤可能未能充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

quote: On the Charades-STA dataset, which assesses the capability to accurately localize events or activities with precise timestamps, Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
claim: 在视频定位上，Charades-STA 的 mIoU 达 50.9，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: As the human evaluation results in table 8 show, Flow Matching leads to better generations both in terms of overall quality and text alignment while controlling for all other factors.
claim: 消融实验显示，Flow Matching 在整体质量和文本对齐上均优于扩散目标 [S3.SS6.SSS2.p4]，LLaMa3 架构在质量（18.6%）和文本对齐（12.6%）上显著优于 Diffusion Transformer [S3.SS6.SSS2.p6]。

quote: This includes the black-box commercial models that offer API access through their website: Runway Gen3, LumaLabs, Kling1.5.
claim: 作者将 Movie Gen Video 与 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs、Kling1.5 和 OpenAI Sora 进行比较，比较时对视频进行下采样以匹配分辨率和宽高比 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p1]。

quote: We train a single joint foundation model, Movie Gen Video, for the text-to-image and the text-to-video tasks.
claim: 作者训练了一个联合的图像与视频生成基础模型 Movie Gen Video，将图像视为单帧视频，采用多阶段训练：先在低分辨率图像上预训练，再进行低分辨率图像与视频联合预训练，最后进行高分辨率联合训练并微调 [S3.p1]。

quote: We find that scaling the training data, compute, and model parameters of a simple Transformer-based model trained with Flow Matching yields high quality generative models for video or audio.

quote: the first-principles supervisor offers the deep learning model supervision signals relating to energies, forces, and stresses on the given structures at the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) level of theory with Hubbard U correction for select materials
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习方法探索广阔材料空间，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: MatterSim achieves a sub- $10\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ error for temperatures up to $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ when compared with QHA computations at PBE level of theory
claim: 自由能预测在 1000 K 以内与 PBE 水平 QHA 计算相比误差低于 10 meV/atom，与 200 多个材料的实验测量相比 MAE 为 15 meV/atom [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: This trained model then functions as an effective surrogate to the first-principles method, guiding the materials explorer to gather more structures
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习方法探索广阔材料空间，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: the current model is trained only on homogeneous bulk systems, without explicit inclusion of surface and interface data that are crucial for applications such as catalysis.
claim: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前采用半局域原子相互作用描述，长程相互作用主要通过消息传递或注意力权重更新实现，在长程相互作用主导性质的情形（如聚合物和异质系统）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。

quote: when compared with experimental measurements on over 200 materials as shown in Fig. S22, it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$
claim: 自由能预测在 1000 K 以内与 PBE 水平 QHA 计算相比误差低于 10 meV/atom，与 200 多个材料的实验测量相比 MAE 为 15 meV/atom [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: The higher interaction energies and heats of adsorption suggest that further fine-tuning data may be required to get quantitatively correct heats of adsorption

quote: Orb models are trained in two distinct phases - first they are trained as Denoising Diffusion models using a dataset of ground state materials.
claim: 模型分两阶段训练：先以基态材料数据集作为去噪扩散模型预训练，再用基础模型初始化神经网络势，以监督方式预测体系的能量、力和应力 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: Figure 4 b shows the root mean squared deviation (RMSD) from the starting state remains relatively constant until 3,000 ps, corresponding to a temperature of 800 K.
claim: 在 MOF-5 上，Orb 在直至 800 K 的温度范围内产生稳定轨迹，并复现了实验中苯撑环不能完全旋转的动力学行为 [S3.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Indeed, the somewhat surprising result that adding in Alexandria to Orb’s training set lowers performance may not be statistically significant across a larger sample of molecules.
claim: 作者指出，零样本 MD17-10k 评估中所有模型性能接近，仅凭四个模拟样本难以稳健判断优劣，且加入 Alexandria 后性能下降的结果在更大分子样本上可能不具统计显著性 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。

quote: Arguably, we have only scratched the surface of this approach through our use of diffusion modeling on ground-states, and we believe that the use of full trajectory data is a promising direction for future work.
claim: 此外，作者认为对扩散建模在基态上的使用只是触及了该方法的表面，使用完整轨迹数据是未来有前景的方向 [S4.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。

quote: Using our 72-qubit processor, we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.
claim: 作者还通过数据量子比特泄漏移除（DQLR）主动抑制泄漏，并运行距离-29重复码以探测超低错误区域 [S2.p3][S4.p2]。

quote: we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11
claim: 在重复码中，作者在d=5到11之间拟合得到Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时观察到偏离指数抑制，出现约10^-10的逻辑错误地板，归因于约每小时发生一次的关联错误爆发 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现低于阈值的量子纠错，即让逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制，这是容错量子计算的基础 [S1.p1]。

quote: Although we might in principle achieve low logical error rates by scaling up our current processors, it would be resource intensive in practice.
claim: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩展现有处理器实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。

quote: Scaling up will also bring additional challenges in real-time decoding as the syndrome measurements per cycle increase quadratically with code distance.
claim: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩展现有处理器实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。
